title: deviceDeliveredAt: delivery path from OS push to mailbox unspecified
description: Peer/receipt deviceDeliveredAt (federation draft): 'MAY be sent when the recipient platform provides a delivery callback (e.g., OS push delivery receipt).' The spec does not describe the path: OS push platforms (APNs, FCM) deliver callbacks asynchronously to a server-side webhook, not to the JMAP client. The mailbox must correlate the push notification ID to a senderMsgId and write back to Message.deliveryReceipts. None of this is specified. Without guidance, implementations will skip deviceDeliveredAt or implement it inconsistently. The spec should acknowledge the out-of-band server-side mechanism required and clarify that this value is not set by the JMAP client.
close_reason: Fixed: deliveryReceipts description now cites APNs/FCM examples and MUST NOT approximate with deliveredAt (chat-00.md:519)
